title: PredicateCoverageReport
description: Predicate-coverage report: the predicate_coverage field below, with one entry per Work Package verification predicate. Place these fields directly as the tool input — no outer wrapper.

predicate_coverage.description: One entry per Work Package verification predicate. Empty only when no predicates were in scope.

wp_id.description: Work Package id (e.g. 'WP-1') the predicate belongs to.

predicate.description: Verbatim verification predicate text copied from the Work Package.

status.description: covered: Tester evidence names a concrete test and that test plausibly proves the predicate. uncovered: no relevant evidence, the named test did not run, or mechanical failures prevent trusting the result. weakly_covered: evidence is tautological, checks only that code runs, asserts only non-null/no-exception behaviour, or does not verify the predicate's meaningful outcome.

evidence.description: Concise pointer to the test method/file or failure signal that drove the decision. Must not be empty.
